name: Fresno de la Polvorosa (Spain)
description: Red field with a white triangle from the upper corners to the centre of the lower edge, charged with a green ash tree.
history: Municipal flag of Fresno de la Polvorosa; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the upper edge and its apex at the lower edge
